risuai.backgroundHTML:
<style>
seikan-side-ui,
.seikan-side-dock {
  z-index: 400 !important;
}
.seikan-floating-ui[open],
.seikan-floating-panel {
  z-index: 401 !important;
}

.x-risu-risu-fold-asset {
  display: block;
  width: min(76%, 390px);
  max-height: clamp(115px, 28vw, 300px);
  margin: 16px auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 14px;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  transition:
    max-height 1.5s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.2,1),
    width .72s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.2,1),
    transform 1.5s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.2,1),
    box-shadow 1.55s ease;
}
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset > img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  margin: 0 auto;
  transform: translateY(-12%) scale(1);
  transform-origin: center top;
  transition: transform 1.5s cubic-bezier(.32,.72,.2,1);
}
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:hover,
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:focus,
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:focus-visible,
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:active {
  width: min(82%, 430px);
  max-height: 600px;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(55,35,65,.16);
  outline: none;
}
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:hover > img,
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:focus > img,
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:focus-visible > img,
.x-risu-risu-fold-asset:active > img {
  transform: translateY(-6%) scale(1.01);
}
</style>
